description: This file defines the Java interface 'WithIdButActuallyNot' which extends 'WithId'. It provides default implementations for 'getId()' and 'getEntityId()' methods, returning dummy entity identifiers. The file includes documentation explaining that this interface serves as a temporary fix for situations where an ID should not be used, despite the interface implying the presence of one.

classes.name: WithIdButActuallyNot
classes.description: A temporary interface to handle cases where an entity is expected to have an ID, but actually does not. It provides default methods returning dummy IDs and includes deprecation notice for 'getId()'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a dummy string ID for the entity; deprecated in favor of 'getEntityId()'.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns a dummy EntityId representing the entity's identifier.
